result.edit: The failure shows incorrect output at cycle 5 when mode=0 (div_e=8). The current comparison uses div_e>>2 (2) instead of div_e>>1 (4) as specified in the waveform contract. This causes the output to be 0 when it should be 1. Changing to div_e>>1 matches the specification's requirement for the output to be 1 when count <= floor(div_e/4)+1 (which equals 3 for div_e=8).
